newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan November index of leading indicators slide.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan November index of leading indicators slide.

text.p: Taiwan's index of leading business indicators, which forecasts peaks and troughs in the business cycle, slid in November from October, the cabinet's Council for Economic Planning and Development said on Friday.
The index declined 0.1 percentage point to 100.5 in November.
The index of coincident indicators also fell, down 0.1 percentage point to 100.9 from a month ago.
The council said the economy improved to a "green light" condition indicating a possible recovery from October's "yellow blue light" condition which indicated a possible slowdown.

Twenty percent of a sample polling of manufacturing executives said the economy would grow worse, slightly down from 22 percent in October, while 13 percent said the economy would improve, down from 19 percent a month earlier.
The rest said the economy would remain unchanged.
Many analysts have expected Taiwan's economy to gradually recover in the fourth quarter of 1996, spurred by improving export orders and industrial output.
